virtualTable.sql:
SELECT m.quadrant_name, (SELECT id FROM atlas.record_validation_status WHERE priority=max(status.priority) LIMIT 1) AS max_valid_status, ST_Multi(ST_Union(m.q_polygon))
FROM pladiascz.m_plants_distribution m, atlas.record_validation_status as status
WHERE m.lft >= (SELECT lft FROM public.taxons WHERE id=%TAXON_ID%) AND m.rgt <= (SELECT rgt FROM public.taxons WHERE id=%TAXON_ID%) AND m.validation_status=status.id
GROUP BY m.quadrant_name
